sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 1.6 (pp. 8-10) gives consonants, 12 vowels with contrastive length, and 1.6.3 Tone: 'Lefa has a basic two tone (H / L) system'; contour tones, non-automatic downstep; only intonation (rising for yes/no questions) mentioned otherwise. The words stress/accent/prominence do not occur in the document.
